---
title: "Scenario explorer"
---

The paper reports the five geographic stress scenarios through a single cross-scenario
summary table. Each scenario, though, produces a full set of exhibits across the whole
intensity range and all four channel-mask arms. This page lets you **pick a scenario
and see all of them.**

Pick a scenario:

```{ojs}
scenarios = [
  {id: "eba",          label: "EBA 2021 adverse (headline)"},
  {id: "giips_debt",   label: "Periphery sovereign repricing (GIIPS)"},
  {id: "russia_shock", label: "Eastern-exposure credit (Russia + CEE)"},
  {id: "asian_debt",   label: "East-Asian sovereign"},
  {id: "north_res",    label: "Northern real-economy"},
  {id: "south_res",    label: "Southern real-economy"}
]
viewof scen = Inputs.select(scenarios, {label: "Scenario", format: d => d.label})
```

```{ojs}
maskFiles = ({
  eba:          FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_eba.csv"),
  giips_debt:   FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_giips_debt.csv"),
  russia_shock: FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_russia_shock.csv"),
  asian_debt:   FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_asian_debt.csv"),
  north_res:    FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_north_res.csv"),
  south_res:    FileAttachment("../data/mask_summary_south_res.csv")
})
contagionFiles = ({
  eba:          FileAttachment("../data/contagion_summary_eba.csv"),
  giips_debt:   FileAttachment("../data/contagion_summary_giips_debt.csv"),
  russia_shock: FileAttachment("../data/contagion_summary_russia_shock.csv"),
  asian_debt:   FileAttachment("../data/contagion_summary_asian_debt.csv"),
  north_res:    FileAttachment("../data/contagion_summary_north_res.csv"),
  south_res:    FileAttachment("../data/contagion_summary_south_res.csv")
})
```

```{ojs}
mask = await maskFiles[scen.id].csv({typed: true})
contagion = await contagionFiles[scen.id].csv({typed: true})
armName = ({mask_S: "Sales only", mask_SU: "+ Unsecured", mask_SUR: "+ Repo", mask_SURC: "+ CB credit"})
armOrder = ["mask_S", "mask_SU", "mask_SUR", "mask_SURC"]
maskT = mask.map(d => ({...d, arm_label: armName[d.arm]}))
```

## System equity loss by intensity

Each line is a channel-mask arm; the gap between "Sales only" and "+ CB credit" is the
framework's effect. Loss is on the wipe-to-zero measure, in percent of pre-shock CET1.

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 820, height: 380, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Shock intensity"},
  y: {label: "System equity loss (%)"},
  color: {legend: true, domain: armOrder.map(a => armName[a]), label: "Arm"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(maskT, {x: "intensity_num", y: "eq_loss_resid_pct", stroke: "arm_label", marker: "circle"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Defaults by intensity

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 820, height: 380, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Shock intensity"},
  y: {label: "Number of defaults"},
  color: {legend: true, domain: armOrder.map(a => armName[a]), label: "Arm"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(maskT, {x: "intensity_num", y: "n_defaults", stroke: "arm_label", marker: "circle"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Central-bank collateral pledged

How much collateral banks pledge at the central-bank window under the full framework,
by intensity.

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 820, height: 340, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Shock intensity"},
  y: {label: "CB pledged (€bn)"},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(maskT.filter(d => d.arm === "mask_SURC"),
               {x: "intensity_num", y: "cb_pledged_bn", fillOpacity: 0.25}),
    Plot.line(maskT.filter(d => d.arm === "mask_SURC"),
              {x: "intensity_num", y: "cb_pledged_bn", marker: "circle"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Loss amplification by intensity

The contagion amplification ratio — induced losses as a fraction of the direct shock —
by arm. Lower is better: it measures how much the fire-sale channel multiplies the
initial hit.

```{ojs}
contagionT = contagion.map(d => ({...d, arm_label: armName[d.config]})).filter(d => d.arm_label)
Plot.plot({
  width: 820, height: 360, grid: true,
  x: {label: "Shock intensity"},
  y: {label: "Amplification ratio"},
  color: {legend: true, domain: armOrder.map(a => armName[a]), label: "Arm"},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(contagionT, {x: "intensity_num", y: "amp_ratio", stroke: "arm_label", marker: "circle"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Notes
All series are cross-seed means over ten seeds for the stochastic arms (repo and
CB-credit); the sales-only and unsecured arms are deterministic. Intensity is scenario-
specific: for the EBA scenario it scales the 2021 adverse markdown, while for the
geographic scenarios it is the write-down fraction on the targeted exposures, so levels
are not comparable across scenarios — compare arms *within* a scenario. Data are
aggregated over the whole 67-bank sample; no bank-level figures are shown.
:::
